place: a dark studio stage, the real first NVIDIA card turning under a spotlight
a game shelf beside it, its boxes dark

moments.what: the real card swings into the spotlight, already turning, a dark game shelf beside it
the shelf's game boxes stay dark, one after another
a single box flickers on, then off
the spotlight flares on the card
the old NVIDIA wordmark writes on above the card
a label writes on: first NVIDIA card
a cyan scan line sweeps over the board
the camera pushes in on the card's big chip

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Almost no game could use NVIDIA's first graphics card.

params.place: on top of NVIDIA's first chip package, its lid lifted, the die glowing

moments.what: the first chip's package sits on the stage, its lid lifting off
the die underneath lights up
the camera glides across the die
the die's grid of cells glows in a wave
the count rolls up on a plate on the die's edge
the camera rises off the die as a glowing smooth dome grows out of it
the dome swells and ripples, a ring draws round it on the stage
the curved surface shines, a label writes on: curves

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Its chip packed about 250K transistors and bet everything on curves.

params.place: a drafting table of light: one glowing sheet bending into a dome

moments.what: a flat glowing sheet lies on a lit table
its grid lines shine
its four corners lift and it bends up into a curve
the curve keeps rising
it closes into a smooth dome, light running over it
the camera slides round the dome, a plate on the table edge lights: one piece
its edges glow amber: one patch
its rim glows
the light slides down its round edge

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Bend one flat sheet into a smooth dome: a single patch, round edges.

params.place: the same dome beside it on the table, sliced into a triangle mesh

moments.what: a second dome slides in beside the smooth one
a rival chip lights up under it
lines slice across the second dome
it breaks into facets
every facet turns flat
the mesh glows cyan, triangle by triangle
the triangles multiply
the mesh fills in denser
the camera dives onto one triangle
its three corners light up and it fills in one sweep
the camera pulls back: the faceted dome next to the smooth one

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Other chips cut that dome into flat triangles. More pieces, each easy to draw.

params.place: an old beige PC on a desk, its monitor glowing, a game being built out of triangles

moments.what: a beige PC tower and monitor light up on a dark desk, the monitor flickering on
a game cartridge-style box slides toward the PC
a label writes on: Microsoft
the monitor fills with a grid
a label writes on: DirectX
a race car shape builds on the monitor, triangle by triangle
a stack of glowing layers rises from the PC
the camera pushes in on the screen
the car's triangle mesh flashes cyan

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Which would games use? Microsoft built DirectX, the Windows games toolkit, around triangles.

place: the game shelf again, triangle games lighting up
the first NVIDIA card alone, its light fading

moments.what: the shelf of game boxes from the start
the boxes light up cyan, one after another
a triangle badge stamps on each lit box
the whole shelf glows cyan
the first NVIDIA card under one lamp
the lamp dims
the card's chip fades to grey
the lamp gutters out to one dim pool

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Game makers chose triangles, and NVIDIA struggled to stay in business.

params.place: the stage relit: the curved dome shatters, a new chip rises in its place

moments.what: the lights snap back on the stage
the curved dome lifts off the table
it cracks
it shatters into sparks and falls away
a new chip starts rising from the table
the new chip rises from the table, a label writes on: RIVA
triangles stream out of the chip
they snap together into a mesh
the mesh spins fast, streaks behind it
the camera drops onto the chip's top
the count plate pulses as it climbs
its count rolls up on a plate beside the die

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: NVIDIA threw the curves away. Its next chip, RIVA, drew triangles fast: 3.5M transistors.

params.place: a data hall: a huge modern GPU module rising beside the tiny first chip

moments.what: the RIVA chip glows, boxes stacking up behind it
the boxes stack higher
a second row of boxes lands
the chips line up, each bigger than the last
the line runs on into the dark
each chip lights as the camera passes
the camera follows it
a server hall lights up around a huge modern GPU module
its board glows
the camera rises over its chip
a label writes on: Rubin
the die's cells light in a wave
the plate's count starts rolling up
the die's wave sweeps back, brighter
the module's memory stacks flash green
the count rolls up on its plate; the tiny first chip shows beside it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: It sold, and NVIDIA never looked back. Today its newest chip, Rubin, packs 336B transistors.

place: the drafting table: the smooth dome and the triangle dome side by side
the dark studio, the first NVIDIA card turning again

moments.what: the smooth dome glows amber
the triangle dome glows cyan
both turn slowly
a balance tips between them
it tips toward the triangles
cut to the dark studio, the first NVIDIA card swinging in
the spotlight comes up on it
its chip flickers
the card settles into the opening shot

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Curves or triangles: which would you pick? NVIDIA learned the hard way.
